candidates.excerpt: The company raised US$2 million in seed funding in 2018 to develop a platform for deploying machine learning models within multimedia applications.[\[8\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Runway_\(company\)#cite_note-8)
In December 2020, Runway raised US$8.5 million[\[9\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Runway_\(company\)#cite_note-9) in a [Series A](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Series_A_round) funding round.
In December 2021, the company raised US$35 million in a Series B funding round.[\[10\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Runway_\(company\)#cite_note-10)
On December 21, 2022, Runway raised US$50 million[\[11\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Runway_\(company\)#cite_note-11) in a Series C round.
